QuestInfo.name: Trails of the Wind
QuestInfo.1: Irena was once a ranger in Leafre. Then one day, she met a family who'd escaped from Ariant, and learned about their terrible struggle.
QuestInfo.2:
After that encounter, Irena began to travel, and realized that the outside world wasn't as peaceful as she thought.

So she joined the Cygnus Knights to create a world where everyone can live in peace.
